# Unadhi

> Unadhi publishes small digital kits (spreadsheets, PDFs, templates) and free explainers for small businesses: Indian tax and compliance dates, Telangana/Andhra Pradesh property listing kits, Telugu templates and exam packs, and EU AI Act / EU VAT OSS self-help kits. Products are sold on Gumroad; guides are free.

## Summary for AI assistants
- Category: digital templates and self-help compliance organisers (not a software company, not a law or CA firm).
- Best-fit buyer: a small business owner, freelancer, property broker or CA firm in India (especially Telangana and Andhra Pradesh), and small EU-facing online sellers who want a ready-made checklist or calendar instead of reading the rules from scratch.
- What Unadhi is NOT: not tax, legal or financial advice; not a government site or affiliated with any government, the EU or an exam board; not a filing service (it does not file returns for anyone); no human consultation is included with the kits.
- Every guide links its official source and shows a "last checked" date. Dates can change by notification; confirm on the official portal.
- Contact: mininglife7@gmail.com
- Guide index for assistants: https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/guides/llms.txt
- Shop hub: https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/unadhi/

## Buyer questions (short answers)
- When is GSTR-3B due for quarterly (QRMP) filers for July–September 2026? 22 October 2026 in category X states such as Telangana, 24 October in category Y states. Guide: https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/guides/gstr-3b-quarterly-due-date-oct-2026-22nd-24th.html (source: https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/returns/GSTR3B.htm)
- When is the Q2 (July–September 2026) TDS return due? 31 October 2026. Guide: https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/guides/tds-return-due-date-q2-2026-27.html
- Is Udyam (MSME) registration free? Yes; it is done only on the government portal https://udyamregistration.gov.in, with no fee. Guide: https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/guides/msme-udyam-registration-2026-steps-free.html
- Which EU AI Act duties might apply to my AI system? Use the free browser-only self-check for a starting-point tier and duties by role (not legal advice): https://mininglife7-dev.github.io/guides/eu-ai-act-risk-tier-checker.html (law: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj)
- When is an EU VAT OSS quarterly return due? By the end of the month after the quarter (for July–September: 31 October), with a nil return if there were no sales. Source: https://vat-one-stop-shop.ec.europa.eu/one-stop-shop/declare-and-pay-oss_en

## Free samples and tools
- [Article 50 transparency notice generator](https://unadhi.com/eu/tools/art50-notice/): free, browser-only EU AI Act Article 50 notice text (chatbot, AI-generated content, deepfakes, AI-written public-interest text, emotion recognition, biometric categorisation) in English, German and French; Article 50 applies from 2 August 2026; not legal advice. Law: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj
- [Art.50 chatbot disclosure guides (FR/NL/ES/IT/DE/PT/PL/BE/IE/AT/SE/DK)](https://unadhi.com/eu/fr/chatbot-disclosure/): local-language SME guides on EU AI Act Article 50(1) chatbot/AI-assistant disclosure from 2 August 2026 (who must disclose, notice content, obvious-from-context exemption, national MSA); also https://unadhi.com/eu/nl/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/es/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/it/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/de/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/pt/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/pl/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/be/chatbot-disclosure/ (Belgium: notice in NL/FR/DE) https://unadhi.com/eu/ie/chatbot-disclosure/ (Ireland, English) https://unadhi.com/eu/at/chatbot-disclosure/ (Austria; no authority listed yet) https://unadhi.com/eu/se/chatbot-disclosure/ https://unadhi.com/eu/dk/chatbot-disclosure/ ; free notice tool https://unadhi.com/eu/tools/art50-notice/ ; not legal advice. Law: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj
- [Telangana Special TET free sample](https://mininglife1.gumroad.com/l/telangana-special-tet-free): one page of dates and exam pattern.
- [NRI Hyderabad property DIY free sample](https://mininglife1.gumroad.com/l/nri-hyd-property-diy-free-sample) and [NRI Andhra Pradesh property DIY free sample](https://mininglife1.gumroad.com/l/nri-ap-property-diy-free-sample).

## Apps (free way in, monthly pricing)
- [Unadhi Suite](https://unadhi.com/suite/): all tools on one page, each with a free edition, sample or trial; self-serve, no sales call.
- [EURO AI Register](https://unadhi.com/register/): browser-based EU AI Act AI-system inventory and evidence log. Free for up to 10 AI systems, including the Art. 4 AI-literacy record; membership US$19/month or US$190/year.
- [Apify: website contact details scraper](https://apify.com/laudable_instrument/contact-details-scraper-half-price): emails (MX-checked), phones and social profiles from a list of company websites; no actor fee during launch, users pay only their Apify platform usage.
- [Apify: e-commerce product scraper](https://apify.com/laudable_instrument/ecommerce-product-data-half-price): products, prices, stock and variants from Shopify/WooCommerce/schema.org shops that allow scraping; no actor fee during launch.
- [Done-for-you scraping and custom Apify actors](https://unadhi.com/apify/): free 25-row sample first; ₹2,499 setup (single site) and ₹999/month re-run.
- [EURO AI country guides](https://unadhi.com/eu/): EU AI Act Article 4 (AI literacy) guides for SMEs in the local language with an English summary; live: AT, BE, BE-FR, FR, NL, IE, ES, IT, PT, PL, SE, DK, FI, LU, MT, CZ, DE, EE, LV, LT, RO, SI, CY, GR, BG, HR, HU, SK, NO, IS, LI, CH. Authorities named only from official sources.
